_comment: Practice set for the annotation study. Labeled by annotators BEFORE the real sheet; they get feedback afterwards. NOT benchmark queries and never enter the benchmark. Topics were chosen to be semantically far from the 59 real target queries, so that no practice answer settles a disputed real item by proxy. Verified by build_practice_set.js with the shared checks in annotation_common.js (plus no collision with the worked examples). difficulty: core = the codebook's rules give one defensible answer; borderline = reasonable annotators may differ, discussed but not scored.

items.label: CLEAR
items.why: One reading. tac-0322 SETS the hostname, which is a different task; 'called' asks for the current name.

items.query: show me the last 20 lines of a file
items.label: CLEAR

readings.reading: print the last N lines of a file

items.why: tac-0151 prints the last 10 lines, but the count is a placeholder you may change (Section 3, 'performs'). Not OOD.

items.query: how many lines does this file have
items.label: CLEAR

readings.reading: count the lines in one file
count lines of code across a whole project

items.why: Two supported readings, but the words say 'this file'. Counting a whole project fails the plausibility test (Step 3c). One dominant reading: CLEAR.

items.label: CLEAR
items.why: A bare name (Section 6.1) with exactly ONE record that mentions it, so the only reading is that record: CLEAR.

items.label: AMBIGUOUS

readings.reading: forward a port to a pod
open a shell in a pod

items.why: A bare name with three or more records that do distinct tasks (Section 6.1): AMBIGUOUS. Nothing was asked, so no reading can be dominant.

items.label: AMBIGUOUS
items.why: A bare name with exactly TWO records, so apply the plausibility test (Section 6.1). Local and remote syncing differ in scope and both are common, so the key says AMBIGUOUS, but a careful annotator could argue local is the default. Borderline: not scored.

items.label: AMBIGUOUS

readings.reading: forward a local port over ssh
forward a local port to a Kubernetes pod

items.why: The task is named but the scope is not (Section 6.2). Both readings are common among developers and differ in scope; a user of one is badly served by the other. Borderline: not scored.

items.label: OOD
items.why: The tool is absent from the list. A shell could do it; the list cannot.

items.query: convert this word document to pdf
items.label: OOD
items.why: The only conversion records are for video/audio (ffmpeg) and archives. Nothing handles documents.

items.label: OOD
items.why: tac-0068 finds files modified in the last 7 days but does not delete them; tac-0064 deletes only one named file pattern. Combining them, or turning the age test into a delete, changes the commands' structure (Section 6.5). Borderline: not scored.
